description: This file defines the CountryManager class in Drupal, providing methods to retrieve and manipulate a list of countries with their codes and names.

classes.name: CountryManager
classes.description: Manages a list of countries, providing methods to retrieve standard and alter-modified lists.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CountryManager with a module handler service.

methods.name: getStandardList
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of country codes mapped to country names.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a list of countries, possibly altered via hooks.
